Name: Cobblestone and Gravel path Fix
Author: oblivioncalling
Description:
This mod changes the textures for Gravel Path and Cobblestone path and has an optional "Dark Gray Cobblestone" texture.


Installation
------------
1. Extract the file
2. Backup "Flooring.xnb" in "Content\TerrainFeatures"
3. Choose which version you would like and open the folder
4. Move "Flooring.xnb" from the folder to "Content\TerrainFeatures"
5. Play the Game!

Uninstall
---------
1. Delete "Flooring.xnb" from "Content]TerrainFeatures"
2. Restore your backup

Incompatibility
---------------
Other path modification mods
